name: Sanemaki Nozomi
source:
Nozomi is a transfer student to Hayato’s class and she’s also the granddaughter of the school principal. She’s from a rich family and so lives in a large mansion with lots of maids. Nozomi is quite outgoing and makes friends easily. She has a love of insects and creepy crawlies, with her favourite being a large spider, this freaks everyone out when they go to her house.

[Taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/12/18/shinsei-ni-shite-okasubekarazu-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
